name: Røros Mining Town and the Circumference
description: Røros is a former copper-mining town in the mountains of central Norway, where miners dug ore for 333 years until 1977. Rebuilt after Swedish troops burned it in 1679, it still has around 2,000 low wooden houses, many with dark, blackened façades that give the streets a medieval look. The protected area also includes a smelter site and an old winter transport route.
